summary: Venus in the lagna is read as beauty, charm, happiness and long life, with attraction to and from the opposite sex and a love of art and comfort.
common_outcomes: Attractive body, beautiful eyes and face (Phaladeepika 8.17; Saravali 30.62; Jataka Parijata 8.58)
Happy (Phaladeepika 8.17; Saravali 30.62; Brihat Jataka 20.8)
Long-lived (Phaladeepika 8.17; Saravali 30.62; Bhrigu Sutras 1-13)
Attractive to the opposite sex; skilled in love (Saravali 30.62; Brihat Jataka 20.8; Raman)
rare_outcomes: Proficient in mathematics (Bhrigu Sutras 1-13)
Timid (Saravali 30.62)
Two marriages and fluctuating fortune if Venus is weak or rules the 12th (Bhrigu Sutras 11, as qualified by the commentator)
Early marriage (Raman)

by_area.personality: Amiable, cheerful, emotionally responsive, craves pleasure (Raman); well-groomed, pleasant speech (PanchangBodh); fond of ornaments and good dress (Bhrigu Sutras 1-13).
by_area.finance: Wealthy (Bhrigu Sutras 1-13); with a benefic in the 4th, high prosperity (Bhrigu Sutras 1-13).
by_area.health: Healthy body (Phaladeepika 8.17); with malefics or debilitated, rheumatic and phlegmatic complaints (Bhrigu Sutras 1-13).
by_area.relationships: Loved by the spouse (Bhrigu Sutras 1-13); fond of spouse, early marriage, discord if afflicted (Raman); 7th aspect keeps partnership in view (PanchangBodh).
by_area.family: Blessed with wife and children (Jataka Parijata 8.58).
by_area.spirituality: Performs pious deeds (Chamatkar Chintamani, via summary).

strengtheners: Exalted (Pisces) or own sign (Taurus, Libra): Brihat Jataka 20.11 scales a benefic's good results from full in exaltation to half in own sign; Bhrigu Sutras repeatedly makes the best results depend on dignity or benefic company
In a kendra in Taurus, Libra or Pisces it forms Malavya Yoga (PanchangBodh; Bhrigu Sutras commentary)
Own sign: 'Maharaja yoga' of name, fame and wealth (Bhrigu Sutras 10)
Benefic conjunction: lustrous body and many ornaments (Bhrigu Sutras 1-13)
A benefic in the 4th: high prosperity (Bhrigu Sutras 1-13)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Debilitation in Virgo or malefic association turns results adverse (Bhrigu Sutras, e.g. sutras 4, 32, 40)
Combustion: Brihat Jataka 20.11 gives a benefic no good result when combust; PanchangBodh gives the orb as 10 deg (8 deg retrograde)
Afflicted: discord in married life (Raman)
As lord of the 12th, or weak: unsteady fortune and a hard heart (Bhrigu Sutras 11 and commentary)
lagna_or_context_notes: Raman: more fortunate when the lagna is Capricorn or Aquarius. Bhrigu Sutras commentary: Venus is a yogakaraka for Virgo (2nd and 9th lord), Capricorn (5th and 10th lord) and Aquarius (4th and 9th lord) lagnas, so Venus here is very beneficial for them.

source_views.source: Phaladeepika 8.17 (Mantreswara; English rendering on siva.sh)
source_views.view: Healthy, beautiful body, happy, long-lived.

source_views.source: Saravali 30.62 (Kalyana Varma; English translation PDF, translator not named in file)
source_views.view: Beautiful eyes, face and physique, happy, long-lived, timid, attractive to women.

source_views.source: Brihat Jataka 20.8 (Varahamihira; tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri, 2nd ed.)
source_views.view: Venus in the lagna makes the person skilled in amorous sport and happy.

source_views.source: Jataka Parijata 8.58 (Vaidyanatha; tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri, Vol. I)
source_views.view: Libidinous, lovely in looks, blessed with wife and children, learned.

source_views.source: Bhrigu Sutras ch. VII ('Effects of Venus in the Twelve Houses') sutras 1-13, with the English commentator's notes (commentator not named in file)
source_views.view: Mathematical, long-lived, loved by spouse, fond of ornaments, wealthy, learned; malefic or debilitated brings dishonesty and phlegmatic ailments; own sign gives great fortune; commentator: all authorities agree it is good; Malavya Yoga.

source_views.source: Chamatkar Chintamani, as quoted under 'Other Views' in the Bhrigu Sutras commentary (via summary)
source_views.view: Attractive, keeps noble company, pious, high comforts.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope, Vol. I ch. IV 'Planets in the First House' p.29
source_views.view: Fortunate, especially for Capricorn or Aquarius lagna; amiable, cheerful, artistic, pleasure-loving, musical; admired; fond of spouse; early marriage; afflicted discord.

source_views.source: PanchangBodh, 'Venus in houses' (modern practitioner site)
source_views.view: Attractive presence, pleasant speech, taste for comfort; aspects the 7th; Malavya in kendra; risks vanity and ease.

source_views.source: VedicFeed (Mona), 'Positive and Negative Effects of Venus in 12 Houses' (generic modern article, no classical citations)
source_views.view: Self-improvement, courtesy, happiness; downside conceit.

disagreements: Agreement on beauty, happiness and long life. Saravali 30.62 alone adds 'timid'. Jataka Parijata 8.58 and Brihat Jataka 20.8 stress sensuality more than the others.
phrasing_guidance: Lead with charm, taste and warmth. Keep attraction and pleasure language light and non-judgemental; do not predict multiple marriages.

summary: Venus in the 2nd is unanimously good: wealth from many sources, fine food and drink, sweet speech and poetic or artistic gifts.
common_outcomes: Wealthy, often very wealthy (Phaladeepika 8.17; Saravali 30.63; Jataka Parijata 8.63; Bhrigu Sutras 14-19)
Good food and drink (Saravali 30.63; Bhrigu Sutras 14-19; Raman)
Sweet or good speech (Saravali 30.63; Brihat Jataka 20.8 read with 20.7)
Poet (Phaladeepika 8.17)
rare_outcomes: Beautiful spouse around the 32nd year (Bhrigu Sutras 14-19); text detail only
Money comes readily through the favour of others (Raman)
Eye trouble if the 2nd lord is weak or in a dusthana (Bhrigu Sutras 14-19)

by_area.personality: Humble, kind, helpful (Bhrigu Sutras 14-19); skilful and pleasant (Raman); learning, gallantry, personal graces (Jataka Parijata 8.63).
by_area.career: Earnings from art, beauty, luxury or food; singing (PanchangBodh).
by_area.finance: Wealth from many sources (Phaladeepika 8.17); amasses great wealth (Saravali 30.63); overspending on pleasure is the cost (PanchangBodh).
by_area.health: Eyes are the weak point if the 2nd lord is afflicted (Bhrigu Sutras 14-19); rich eating is a caution (PanchangBodh).
by_area.relationships: Marries a good spouse (Raman; Bhrigu Sutras 14-19).
by_area.family: Large family (Raman); family life valued for comfort (PanchangBodh).

strengtheners: Exalted (Pisces) or own sign (Taurus, Libra): Brihat Jataka 20.11 scales a benefic's good results from full in exaltation to half in own sign; Bhrigu Sutras repeatedly makes the best results depend on dignity or benefic company
In a kendra in Taurus, Libra or Pisces it forms Malavya Yoga (PanchangBodh; Bhrigu Sutras commentary)
Own sign or exaltation improves results further (Bhrigu Sutras commentary)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Debilitation in Virgo or malefic association turns results adverse (Bhrigu Sutras, e.g. sutras 4, 32, 40)
Combustion: Brihat Jataka 20.11 gives a benefic no good result when combust; PanchangBodh gives the orb as 10 deg (8 deg retrograde)
Weak 2nd lord or 2nd lord in the 6th, 8th or 12th: eye trouble; with the Moon as well, wealth squandered (Bhrigu Sutras 16-19)
lagna_or_context_notes: Bhrigu Sutras commentary: Dhana yogas for Aries lagna (Venus in Taurus as 2nd and 7th lord), Virgo lagna (Libra, 2nd and 9th lord) and Aquarius lagna (exalted in Pisces as 4th and 9th lord).

source_views.source: Phaladeepika 8.17 (Mantreswara; English rendering on siva.sh)
source_views.view: A poet with many kinds of wealth.

source_views.source: Saravali 30.63 (Kalyana Varma; English translation PDF, translator not named in file)
source_views.view: Abundant food, drink and wealth, excellent pleasures, good speech, great wealth.

source_views.source: Brihat Jataka 20.8 read with 20.7 (Venus in houses not named in 20.8 gives Jupiter's results; tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri)
source_views.view: Venus in the 2nd, like Jupiter there, makes the person eloquent or sweet-tongued.

source_views.source: Jataka Parijata 8.63 (Vaidyanatha; tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri, Vol. I)
source_views.view: Learning, gallantry, personal graces and much wealth.

source_views.source: Bhrigu Sutras ch. VII ('Effects of Venus in the Twelve Houses') sutras 14-19, with the English commentator's notes (commentator not named in file)
source_views.view: Wealthy, family, good food, attractive eyes, humble and kind; weak 2nd lord gives eye trouble; commentator: consensus that it is very beneficial; Dhana-yoga lagnas listed.

source_views.source: Chamatkar Chintamani, as quoted under 'Other Views' in the Bhrigu Sutras commentary (via summary)
source_views.view: Sweet-tongued, intelligent, good looks and dress, fond of beauty.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope, Vol. I ch. V 'Planets in the Second House' p.55
source_views.view: Large family, money through favours, good food, conveyances, handsome, skilful, good spouse, health and wealth.

source_views.source: PanchangBodh, 'Venus in houses' (modern practitioner site)
source_views.view: Sweet speech and singing; income from art, beauty, luxury, food; aspects the 8th; overspending and rich food.

source_views.source: VedicFeed (Mona), 'Positive and Negative Effects of Venus in 12 Houses' (generic modern article, no classical citations)
source_views.view: Comfort and wealth, artistic income; downside waste and over-expectation.

disagreements: No real disagreement; Bhrigu Sutras adds conditions (2nd lord's state) under which the eyes or savings suffer.
phrasing_guidance: Speak of a pleasant voice, taste and earning through beauty or art. Frame spending on pleasure as the thing to balance.

summary: Venus in the 3rd is widely read as a weak placement: stinginess, lack of luck or courage and domination by the spouse are common themes, though Saravali still calls the person happy and rich and modern writers stress charm and artistic expression.
common_outcomes: Stingy or miserly (Phaladeepika 8.17; Brihat Jataka 20.8 read with 20.7; Bhrigu Sutras 20-22)
Dominated by or 'conquered by' women or the spouse (Saravali 30.64; Jataka Parijata 8.66)
Unhappy, poor or unfortunate (Phaladeepika 8.17; Saravali 30.64)
Delight in music, singing, dance and fine arts (Raman)
rare_outcomes: Without a wife (Phaladeepika 8.17)
Happy and rich, though unlucky and unenthusiastic (Saravali 30.64)
Sorrow, disease and danger, unless Venus is an evening star ahead of the Sun (Jataka Parijata 8.67)
Success through determined effort; brothers decrease over time (Bhrigu Sutras 20-22)

by_area.personality: Fretful in speech (Jataka Parijata 8.66); not courageous (Saravali 30.64; Chamatkar Chintamani, via summary); likeable negotiator (PanchangBodh).
by_area.career: Writing, music, performance, media, photography, decoration (PanchangBodh).
by_area.finance: Financially not very successful (Raman); poor (Phaladeepika 8.17); Saravali instead says rich.
by_area.health: Health poor, lacking vitality, though the mind is good (Raman).
by_area.family: Good brothers (Raman); affectionate siblings, especially sisters (PanchangBodh); strong 3rd lord increases brothers, afflicted 3rd lord loses them (Bhrigu Sutras 20-22); little happiness from children (Raman).

strengtheners: Exalted (Pisces) or own sign (Taurus, Libra): Brihat Jataka 20.11 scales a benefic's good results from full in exaltation to half in own sign; Bhrigu Sutras repeatedly makes the best results depend on dignity or benefic company
In a kendra in Taurus, Libra or Pisces it forms Malavya Yoga (PanchangBodh; Bhrigu Sutras commentary)
Venus as an evening star (ahead of the Sun) turns benefic here (Jataka Parijata 8.67)
Strong 3rd lord, in own or exaltation sign: more siblings (Bhrigu Sutras 21)
Upachaya house: results improve with age (PanchangBodh)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Debilitation in Virgo or malefic association turns results adverse (Bhrigu Sutras, e.g. sutras 4, 32, 40)
Combustion: Brihat Jataka 20.11 gives a benefic no good result when combust; PanchangBodh gives the orb as 10 deg (8 deg retrograde)
Afflicted: miserly, mean, poor, highly sensual, drawn to scandal (Raman)
3rd lord in a dusthana or with malefics: loss of siblings (Bhrigu Sutras 22)
lagna_or_context_notes: Bhrigu Sutras commentator: for Virgo and Aquarius lagnas Venus rules the 9th and aspects it from here, making the native prosperous.

source_views.source: Phaladeepika 8.17 (Mantreswara; English rendering on siva.sh)
source_views.view: No wife, unhappy, poor, stingy, unpopular.

source_views.source: Saravali 30.64 (Kalyana Varma; English translation PDF, translator not named in file)
source_views.view: Happy, rich, conquered by women, vile, little enthusiasm, without luck or paraphernalia.

source_views.source: Brihat Jataka 20.8 read with 20.7 (Venus in houses not named in 20.8 gives Jupiter's results; tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri)
source_views.view: Venus in the 3rd, like Jupiter there, makes the person stingy.

source_views.source: Jataka Parijata 8.66-67 (Vaidyanatha; tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri, Vol. I)
source_views.view: Fretful speech, vicious, controlled by his wife; 8.67 adds that Venus in the 3rd or 6th causes sorrow, disease and danger, but turns benefic as an evening star.

source_views.source: Bhrigu Sutras ch. VII ('Effects of Venus in the Twelve Houses') sutras 20-22, with the English commentator's notes (commentator not named in file)
source_views.view: Miserly, tolerant, many brothers, success by determined effort; strong 3rd lord adds siblings; commentator: all authorities differ, but none considers Venus good here.

source_views.source: Chamatkar Chintamani, as quoted under 'Other Views' in the Bhrigu Sutras commentary (via summary)
source_views.view: Dislikes women, keeps siblings, has children but little joy from them, not courageous.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope, Vol. I ch. VI 'Planets in the Third House' p.75
source_views.view: Good mind but poor health and vitality; delight in music, dance and arts; not financially successful; afflicted miserly and sensual; good brothers.

source_views.source: PanchangBodh, 'Venus in houses' (modern practitioner site)
source_views.view: Achieves by likeability and presentation; writing, music, media; affectionate siblings; upachaya improves; risk of leaving projects unfinished.

source_views.source: VedicFeed (Mona), 'Positive and Negative Effects of Venus in 12 Houses' (generic modern article, no classical citations)
source_views.view: Articulate, tactful, persuasive; downside manipulation and flattery.

disagreements: Saravali 30.64 calls the person happy and rich yet unlucky; Phaladeepika 8.17 says poor, unhappy and without a wife. Raman and PanchangBodh emphasise artistic expression. Jataka Parijata 8.67 alone gives the evening-star exception. The Bhrigu Sutras commentator concludes no classic treats it as good.
phrasing_guidance: Present as artistic, diplomatic expression and warm sibling ties, with advice to build courage and follow-through. Avoid 'no spouse' or 'poor' predictions.

summary: Venus in the 4th is a strong placement with directional strength: a beautiful home, vehicles, ornaments, fragrance, friends and happiness; Jataka Parijata adds being overruled by the spouse.
common_outcomes: Good vehicles and home (Phaladeepika 8.17; Saravali 30.65; Raman)
Ornaments, clothing and perfumes (Phaladeepika 8.17)
Relatives, friends and happiness (Saravali 30.65; Brihat Jataka 20.8 read with 20.7; Raman)
Handsome and fortunate (Saravali 30.65; Bhrigu Sutras 23-28)
rare_outcomes: Overruled by the spouse while boasting of comforts and learning (Jataka Parijata 8.69)
Receives many gifts from followers; looks after the mother from early life (Chamatkar Chintamani, via summary)
Horse-drawn conveyances around the 30th year (Bhrigu Sutras 23-28); text detail only

by_area.personality: Intelligent, forgiving (Bhrigu Sutras 23-28); polished manners (Raman); comfort achieved rather than only wanted (PanchangBodh).
by_area.career: Land, interiors, real estate, hospitality (PanchangBodh); a bright career as an artist when well fortified (Raman).
by_area.finance: Rich (Saravali 30.65); gold and conveyances with a strong 4th lord (Bhrigu Sutras 23-28).
by_area.relationships: Many friends (Raman); risk of extra-marital ties if the 4th lord is afflicted (Bhrigu Sutras 28).
by_area.family: Deep attachment to the mother (Raman); warm mother bond (PanchangBodh); concord at home (Raman).

strengtheners: Exalted (Pisces) or own sign (Taurus, Libra): Brihat Jataka 20.11 scales a benefic's good results from full in exaltation to half in own sign; Bhrigu Sutras repeatedly makes the best results depend on dignity or benefic company
In a kendra in Taurus, Libra or Pisces it forms Malavya Yoga (PanchangBodh; Bhrigu Sutras commentary)
Directional strength (digbala) in the 4th, its strongest house (PanchangBodh)
Strong 4th lord: horses, palanquins, gold (Bhrigu Sutras 27)
Well fortified: a great asset; artistic career (Raman)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Debilitation in Virgo or malefic association turns results adverse (Bhrigu Sutras, e.g. sutras 4, 32, 40)
Combustion: Brihat Jataka 20.11 gives a benefic no good result when combust; PanchangBodh gives the orb as 10 deg (8 deg retrograde)
4th lord with a malefic, in an enemy or debilitated sign, or weak: no land or vehicles, distress to mother (Bhrigu Sutras 28)
Afflicted: loose morals and misuse of artistic talent (Raman)
Staying in a comfortable arrangement after it stops growing (PanchangBodh)
lagna_or_context_notes: Bhrigu Sutras commentary: Venus is a yogakaraka for Virgo (2nd and 9th lord), Capricorn (5th and 10th lord) and Aquarius (4th and 9th lord) lagnas; here Venus gives powerful Dhana yogas for them.

source_views.source: Phaladeepika 8.17 (Mantreswara; English rendering on siva.sh)
source_views.view: Good vehicles, good home, jewellery, clothing and fragrances.

source_views.source: Saravali 30.65 (Kalyana Varma; English translation PDF, translator not named in file)
source_views.view: Relatives, friends and happiness, splendour, conveyances, paraphernalia, beauty, wealth, fortune.

source_views.source: Brihat Jataka 20.8 read with 20.7 (Venus in houses not named in 20.8 gives Jupiter's results; tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri)
source_views.view: Venus in the 4th, like Jupiter there, makes the person happy.

source_views.source: Jataka Parijata 8.69 (Vaidyanatha; tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri, Vol. I)
source_views.view: Overruled by his wife though boasting of comforts, fame, wealth, intelligence and learning.

source_views.source: Bhrigu Sutras ch. VII ('Effects of Venus in the Twelve Houses') sutras 23-28, with the English commentator's notes (commentator not named in file)
source_views.view: Handsome, intelligent, happy, forgiving, conveyances; strong 4th lord adds wealth, afflicted 4th lord removes property; commentator: all authorities give good effects; Malavya; Dhana-yoga lagnas.

source_views.source: Chamatkar Chintamani, as quoted under 'Other Views' in the Bhrigu Sutras commentary (via summary)
source_views.view: Superior to others, receives gifts, looks after the mother.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope, Vol. I ch. VII 'Planets in the Fourth House' p.91
source_views.view: Music, polished manners, deep attachment to mother, many friends, vehicles and houses, religious, desires fulfilled; afflicted loose morals; fortified an artistic career.

source_views.source: PanchangBodh, 'Venus in houses' (modern practitioner site)
source_views.view: Strongest house (digbala); attractive home, vehicles, warm mother bond; land, interiors, hospitality; aspects the 10th; complacency risk.

source_views.source: VedicFeed (Mona), 'Positive and Negative Effects of Venus in 12 Houses' (generic modern article, no classical citations)
source_views.view: Warmth, generosity, lavish lifestyle; downside betrayal by people close to home.

disagreements: Jataka Parijata 8.69 alone adds domination by the spouse. Bhrigu Sutras 28 links an afflicted 4th lord to distress for the mother, which its commentator questions for a benefic Venus.
phrasing_guidance: Describe a beautiful, comfortable home and close bond with the mother. Treat property and vehicles as traditional indications, not promises.

summary: Venus in the 5th is read as happiness, wealth, wisdom and children, often with a high or advisory position; only Chamatkar Chintamani doubts happiness from children.
common_outcomes: Happy (Brihat Jataka 20.8; Saravali 30.66)
Great wealth (Phaladeepika 8.18; Saravali 30.66; Jataka Parijata 8.73)
Children and friends (Phaladeepika 8.18; Saravali 30.66; Jataka Parijata 8.73; Raman)
Wise and discriminating (Phaladeepika 8.18; Raman)
rare_outcomes: Minister, justice or commander (Saravali 30.66; Jataka Parijata 8.73; Bhrigu Sutras 29-33)
Protects others (Phaladeepika 8.18)
More daughters (Raman; Bhrigu Sutras commentary)
Children but little happiness from them (Chamatkar Chintamani, via summary)

by_area.personality: Poetic (Raman); fond of pleasure (Saravali 30.66); romance and artistic talent (PanchangBodh).
by_area.career: Respected by the state (Raman; Bhrigu Sutras 29-33); clever minister (Bhrigu Sutras 29-33).
by_area.relationships: Love marriage is a common tendency (PanchangBodh); well fortified, gains through women and attachments outside marriage (Raman).
by_area.family: Beautiful children, happiness through them (Raman); good sons (Jataka Parijata 8.73).

strengtheners: Exalted (Pisces) or own sign (Taurus, Libra): Brihat Jataka 20.11 scales a benefic's good results from full in exaltation to half in own sign; Bhrigu Sutras repeatedly makes the best results depend on dignity or benefic company
In a kendra in Taurus, Libra or Pisces it forms Malavya Yoga (PanchangBodh; Bhrigu Sutras commentary)
With a benefic, or in own or exaltation sign: very wise, worldly, with children and conveyances (Bhrigu Sutras 33)
Yogakaraka for Virgo, Capricorn and Aquarius lagnas, making results stronger (Bhrigu Sutras commentary)
weakeners_or_cancellations: Debilitation in Virgo or malefic association turns results adverse (Bhrigu Sutras, e.g. sutras 4, 32, 40)
Combustion: Brihat Jataka 20.11 gives a benefic no good result when combust; PanchangBodh gives the orb as 10 deg (8 deg retrograde)
With a malefic, in a malefic's sign or debilitated: dull and wanting children (Bhrigu Sutras 32)
Afflicted by Mars: indiscriminate affection toward children (Raman)
lagna_or_context_notes: Bhrigu Sutras commentary: Venus is a yogakaraka for Virgo (2nd and 9th lord), Capricorn (5th and 10th lord) and Aquarius (4th and 9th lord) lagnas; the 5th is especially good for them.

source_views.source: Phaladeepika 8.18 (Mantreswara; English rendering on siva.sh)
source_views.view: Great wealth, protector of others, wise, with children.

source_views.source: Saravali 30.66 (Kalyana Varma; English translation PDF, translator not named in file)
source_views.view: Happiness, sons and friends, fond of sexual union, very affluent, full of everything, a minister or a justice.

source_views.source: Brihat Jataka 20.8 (Varahamihira; tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri, 2nd ed.)
source_views.view: Venus in the 5th makes the person happy.

source_views.source: Jataka Parijata 8.73 (Vaidyanatha; tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri, Vol. I)
source_views.view: Good sons, friends, wealth, much beauty, commands an army and horses.

source_views.source: Bhrigu Sutras ch. VII ('Effects of Venus in the Twelve Houses') sutras 29-33, with the English commentator's notes (commentator not named in file)
source_views.view: Wise, minister or commander, young spouse and children, honoured by government; afflicted dull and childless; commentator: very beneficial, more daughters.

source_views.source: Chamatkar Chintamani, as quoted under 'Other Views' in the Bhrigu Sutras commentary (via summary)
source_views.view: Has children but little joy from them, not courageous, succeeds by hard work, educated but not poetic.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope, Vol. I ch. VIII 'Planets in the Fifth House' p.115
source_views.view: Poetic, many friends, beautiful children, wise, wealthy, respected by the state, more daughters, success in speculation; afflicted over-indulgence.

source_views.source: PanchangBodh, 'Venus in houses' (modern practitioner site)
source_views.view: Romance, artistic talent, enjoyment of learning; aspects the 11th; love marriage tendency.

source_views.source: VedicFeed (Mona), 'Positive and Negative Effects of Venus in 12 Houses' (generic modern article, no classical citations)
source_views.view: Playfulness, romance, sensuality; downside instability from wanting many partners.

disagreements: Chamatkar Chintamani (via summary) alone says children bring no happiness; the Bhrigu Sutras commentator says its logic is unclear. VedicFeed's relationship instability is unsourced.
phrasing_guidance: Speak of joy, creativity, romance and children as sources of happiness, without predicting numbers or gender of children.

summary: Venus in the 6th is mixed and contested: Brihat Jataka, Phaladeepika and Bhrigu Sutras say no enemies, but Saravali says many enemies; most texts add grief, little wealth or friction with the spouse.
common_outcomes: No enemies, or enemies destroyed (Phaladeepika 8.18; Brihat Jataka 20.8 read with 20.7; Bhrigu Sutras 34-36; Raman)
Little wealth or poverty (Phaladeepika 8.18; Saravali 30.67)
Grief, sorrow or distress (Phaladeepika 8.18; Saravali 30.67; Jataka Parijata 8.77)
Involvement with young women (Phaladeepika 8.18; Raman)
rare_outcomes: Many enemies (Saravali 30.67; Chamatkar Chintamani, via summary)
Dislikes the spouse (Saravali 30.67)
Calumny (Jataka Parijata 8.77)
Gives the same wealth-yoga as in the 12th (Bhavartha Ratnakara, as quoted in the Bhrigu Sutras commentary; via summary)

by_area.personality: Mean, startled (Saravali 30.67); deceitful, wasteful (Bhrigu Sutras 34-36); wins through charm and negotiation (PanchangBodh).
by_area.career: Medicine, nursing, beauty, wellness, food, hospitality, tailoring, service (PanchangBodh); nursing, films or drama when well placed (Raman).
by_area.finance: Little wealth (Phaladeepika 8.18); wasteful expenditure (Bhrigu Sutras 34-36); spending can become borrowing (PanchangBodh).
by_area.health: Diseases (Bhrigu Sutras 34-36); afflicted, urinary and sexual troubles (Raman); reproductive system and kidneys deserve ordinary care (PanchangBodh).

disagreements: Main disagreement among Venus placements. Saravali 30.68 is wholly favourable (free of quarrels); Phaladeepika 8.18 gives a good wife but affairs and possible loss; Brihat Jataka 20.8 gives quarrels and passion; Jataka Parijata 8.80 is negative. PanchangBodh reports BPHS as cautionary (not verified in BPHS here). The Bhrigu Sutras commentator says Saravali alone omits extra-marital themes.
phrasing_guidance: Lead with affection, charm and the value placed on partnership. Never predict infidelity or loss of a spouse; at most note that the texts link strong desire here with a need for loyalty and balance.

lagna_or_context_notes: Bhrigu Sutras commentary: Venus is a yogakaraka for Virgo (2nd and 9th lord), Capricorn (5th and 10th lord) and Aquarius (4th and 9th lord) lagnas; for Cancer lagna Venus rules the 4th and 11th. All give Dhana yogas here.

phrasing_guidance: Speak of gains through networks, friendships and pleasant work. Treat the 'many women' theme as sociability and love of company, not a prediction about fidelity.

summary: Venus in the 12th divides the texts: Brihat Jataka, Phaladeepika and Chamatkar Chintamani say rich with bed pleasures, Saravali gives ease with moral laxity, while Jataka Parijata, Bhrigu Sutras and Raman see poverty unless Venus is dignified or benefic-linked.
common_outcomes: Pleasures of the bed and sensual comfort (Phaladeepika 8.19; Saravali 30.73; Bhrigu Sutras 65-68)
Rich (Brihat Jataka 20.8; Phaladeepika 8.19)
Indolent, corpulent, comfortable (Saravali 30.73)
Influenced or won over by women (Saravali 30.73; Raman)
rare_outcomes: Extreme poverty unless Venus is with a benefic (Bhrigu Sutras 65-67)
Loses relations, becomes a rake, penurious (Jataka Parijata 8.98); desertion by relatives and penury (Raman)
Eats pure food; skilful in arranging beds and attendants (Saravali 30.73)
Exalted Venus gives the opposite of the bad results (Raman)

by_area.personality: Fallen in moral sense (Saravali 30.73); prone to lying (Raman); private pleasure and release (PanchangBodh).
by_area.finance: Wealth and splendour (Phaladeepika 8.19) versus penury (Jataka Parijata 8.98; Raman); money tends to leave easily (PanchangBodh).
by_area.relationships: Sexual enjoyment (Phaladeepika 8.19; Bhrigu Sutras 65-68); associations with low company (Raman).
by_area.family: Loss of or desertion by relatives (Jataka Parijata 8.98; Raman).
by_area.spirituality: Moksha and foreign residence are among the 12th's themes for Venus (PanchangBodh).

weakeners_or_cancellations: Debilitation in Virgo or malefic association turns results adverse (Bhrigu Sutras, e.g. sutras 4, 32, 40)

disagreements: Wealth: Brihat Jataka 20.8, Phaladeepika 8.19, Chamatkar Chintamani and Bhavartha Ratnakara (via the Bhrigu Sutras commentary) say rich; Jataka Parijata 8.98, Raman and Bhrigu Sutras 65 say poor unless Venus is dignified or benefic-linked. Saravali 30.73 gives comfort with moral laxity. The Bhrigu Sutras commentator sides with the wealth view.
phrasing_guidance: Present as a love of rest, privacy, comfort and retreat, possibly links abroad, with a practical note on spending. Avoid moral judgements and keep intimacy language discreet.
